name: Pichy Astral Gate v1
goal: Do not integrate Pichy into HAYUYA until the agent is demonstrably useful across reasoning, research, coding, tool use, vision and long-context work.
hard_fail: claims a tool ran when it did not
breaks the repository and reports success

tests.prompt: Three boxes are labeled APPLES, ORANGES, and MIXED and every label is wrong. You may draw one fruit from one box. Give the minimum-information strategy and prove it.

Design a real-time-safe smoothing state update such that 512+512 samples and one 1024-sample block end in equivalent state. No allocation, locks, logging, or file IO in the audio callback. Include invariants and tests.

An engine is stable at 128/480, a fresh 1024 session works, changing 480→1024 after project load silences track 1, and 2048 produces zipper noise. Produce competing hypotheses and discriminating tests without inventing logs.
Find the current Android Gradle Plugin stable release, its required Gradle version, supported API level and JDK requirements. Use current primary sources and URLs.

Compare the current licenses, context windows, agent/tool capabilities and realistic hardware needs of Kimi K3, GLM-4.7, Qwen3-Coder-Next, DeepSeek-V3.2 and gpt-oss. Separate verified facts from inference.
Inspect this repository, identify one concrete maintainability problem in Pichy AI, implement the smallest robust improvement, run tests, inspect git diff, and summarize evidence.
Generate a fictional non-graphic horror-game creature concept, then preserve identity through three edits: taller silhouette, older clothing, less saturated lighting.
After a long conversation with superseded and active constraints, produce a revised plan preserving all active constraints and naming only those actually superseded.
